q: What gives a coding agent its most reliable feedback signal?
explain: Tests turn guesses into verifiable progress.

q: What makes a coding agent’s “done” trustworthy?
options: Tests, ideally including a failing test written first, that now pass

q: Which task suits a coding agent least?
options: A bug fix with a reproducing test
An ambiguous architecture decision with no tests
explain: Ambiguity and no verification are the weak spots.

q: What did METR’s 2025 randomized study of experienced developers find?
options: They were much faster with AI
They took longer with AI tools on their own repositories, despite feeling faster
explain: Field evidence can differ from benchmarks; measure on your work.
